content_sections.text: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited (GACL) has released the Recruitment 2026 notification for Manager/ Senior Engineer (Process), Officer (Purchase), and Assistant Engineer (Mechanical) posts at its Dahej and Baroda (Vadodara) units in Gujarat. content_sections.heading: GACL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for GACL Recruitment 2026 is based on educational qualification and relevant work experience, which vary by post. B.E./ B.Tech (Chemical) from a government-recognized university Minimum 8 years of experience in the operation of a continuous process chemical plant Experience in the operation of a Phosphoric Acid Plant preferred B.E./ B.Tech in Mechanical/ Electrical/ Instrumentation from a government-recognized university Minimum 5 to 6 years of experience in engineering procurement B.E./ B.Tech (Mechanical), full time, from a government-recognized university Minimum 2 years of experience in the operation of a continuous process chemical plant Experience in the operation of a Phosphoric Acid Plant preferred

content_sections.heading: GACL Recruitment 2026 Job Profile and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: This role is responsible for safe, round-the-clock operation of the process plant. Key responsibilities include: Hands-on operation experience in Reaction, Distillation, Chlorination, and Liquid-Liquid Extraction processes, with large-scale chemical plant exposure preferred Handling hazardous chemicals and working with utility/ auxiliary systems such as Instrument Air, Nitrogen, Cooling Tower, Filter Press, ETP, and solid handling systems Working in shift duty and functioning as section in-charge, with the ability to stabilize plant operations Mandatory hands-on knowledge of Distributed Control System (DCS) operations, including safe start-up/ emergency shutdown and PLC monitoring on a 24-hour basis Monitoring and analyzing daily operational data to meet production, quality, and consumption targets Experience with HAZOP recommendations, Permit to Work (PTW), Lock-Out/ Tag-Out (LOTO), Job Safety Analysis (JSA), and emergency response Working knowledge of MS Office and SAP, and adherence to SOPs, safety standards, and Integrated Management System (IMS) guidelines covering Quality, Environment, Health and Safety This role manages engineering procurement end-to-end, from sourcing to vendor and commercial management. Core responsibilities include: Technical Procurement: Sourcing engineering materials such as mechanical components, electrical items, instrumentation, pipes/ valves/ fittings, motors/ pumps/ bearings, fabrication materials, and industrial consumables, with a basic understanding of technical specifications, drawings, BOQs, datasheets, and standards Vendor Management: Identifying and evaluating suppliers, floating RFQs/ RFPs, comparing techno-commercial offers, conducting vendor audits and performance evaluations, and developing alternate vendors Commercial Activities: Price negotiation, payment terms finalization, delivery scheduling, warranty and penalty clause management, purchase order preparation, and cost optimization within budget Coordination: Working closely with vendors, engineering, production, QA/ QC, stores/ logistics, and finance teams, and tracking material delivery timelines for critical items Documentation and ERP: Maintaining procurement records, working on SAP ERP, and preparing MIS reports and procurement trackers The role also requires strong negotiation, communication, follow-up, analytical, and time-management skills, along with a positive attitude and the ability to prioritize and optimize procurement workflows. This role supports mechanical maintenance and reliability across the plant. Key responsibilities include: Maintenance of high-speed turbo compressors, reciprocating compressors, chillers, pumps, heat exchangers, material handling equipment, sludge separation equipment, and non-metallic equipment (FRP, CSRL, PTFE line, glass line reactors, etc.) Experience with Preventive Maintenance (PM) and Predictive Maintenance (PDM) methodology, work in hazardous areas, NDT, SAP, and handling explosive gas environments Ex
